opDesc: Partial data extracted from upstream output data
description: Extract part of the upstream output data and provide external process tool references

option.name: Variable Name or Data
option.help: Upstream Output Variable Name or JSON Data

option.name: Field Selection
option.help:
For JSON data, use Python syntax to select a field. For text data, use a regular expression.
Regular expression example: Now Date:\s*([\d-\s:]+)
JSON object example (data is the JSON object supplied in the parameter): data['attr'][0]['myfield']

option.name: Extraction Method
option.help: Method of extracting different types of data
